summary: Reviewed both editions independently against all twelve paragraphs of the supplied working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the good/evil contrast, necessity and negation, the working paragraph 6 speaker attribution, every practical instruction, the salvation assertion, and both closing conditions. Reader-facing “servant” follows current policy; the restoration instruction is not homogenized into an added repentance formula. Notes distinguish editorial supplements and corrections from preserved wording and disclose substantive alternatives without replacing the selected working readings. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied source and disclosure of the stated alternatives; it does not verify the cited scans, manuscript readings, historical explanations, or an exhaustive collation.
